<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows seven signals in the aromatic region (110‑160 ppm): 138.76, 131.45 (two signals), 130.59 (two signals), and 121.30 ppm. Counting each distinct carbon signal gives 6 aromatic carbon atoms. The remaining signals (43.47 and 38.60 ppm) are aliphatic. Therefore, the compound contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
